name: s81su_qbtl_ref-v3-pinko-57ee0354e
purpose: QB tap, low half-tap: slots 0-7 (4,096 b, pin flop + output flop) + the tap control (job, row counter, valid, tags, obase, FP4, status); with dsfd_su_t_swth (slots 8-15, hardened once for SW and QB) it replaces dsfd_su_t_qbt; lockstep-exact against ot_s81_su_qbt in the same cycle | v2: v1 EARLY_FAIL_CONGESTION GRT-0116 (H overflow only in a 1.2-um band at x 26.2-27.4 over the whole height, nets e_d* / ot_outhold_*: kit recipe 2 put the 3-cell output hold stage of all 4,096 outputs FIRM at one x on a face with 10.4 b/um, so the legalised chains zigzag: 4 crossings a bit, ~47 H wires/um against 18 a gcell). v2: outhold off -- the output flop sits at its pin in the 4-column pin-flop array (flop -> pin a few um); the hold margin of the outgoing hop is the receiver's input hold stage (every SU tile input keeps its HB4 pair); inputs unchanged (in-hold pair + pin flop FIRM at the W face, no marker there in v1). | v3: v2 routed CLOSED (TT +315.50 / FF +16.97 / DRC 0) but its view failed child_lint (f): 33 of 8,462 face pins (e_f4, e_ob, ... in the control band of the E face) lie under M5 wires on the INNER half of the 0.192-um pin, which the default pin keepout (outer half, OT_PK_FRAC 0.5) leaves open; pin_access frac 1.0 keeps M5 off the whole pin depth on both faces.

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: the single 572.4 x 453.6 tap closed (v4) with 26 control endpoints 4 levels behind dn_st / dn_v[0] and its data crossing 572 um on ONE register; registered at the pins on both faces (v5 kit) it has 16,510 sinks on one root and measured CTS insertion 774 ps / spread 130 ps: refused by the clock rule. It is replaced by TWO half-taps, each a 36.72 x 453.6 column with its own clock root and 4,096 straight M4 bit tracks W -> E: ot_s81_su_qbtl (slots 0-7 + control, ~8.5k sinks) and the data half-tap dsfd_su_t_swth (slots 8-15, 8,192 sinks; the SW tile, hardened once); every input pin on its own flop, every output a flop; cycle count unchanged (composition 3,149)
